extracted.name: Spaghetti Skillet Dinner
extracted.description: This quick and easy one-skillet spaghetti and beef dinner with mushrooms, bell peppers, and mozzarella cheese is sure to become a family favorite!
ingredient_lines: 1 (28 ounce) can whole peeled tomatoes, with liquid
instruction_lines: In a skillet over medium heat, brown ground beef with onions.

Mix in green pepper and mushrooms; cook for a few minutes. Add tomatoes with juice, spaghetti, and water; stir well. Add Italian seasoning, salt, and pepper. Cook for about 15 minutes, stirring occasionally, until spaghetti is tender. Add mozzarella cheese and stir until melted.
